Metadata.title: PCBuilderAI — Expert PC builds, explained
Metadata.description: Build a compatible PC with sourced prices, clear trade-offs, and expert AI guidance.

Hero.title: A PC expert that works through every trade-off with you.
Hero.description: Describe your budget, games, work, preferences, and parts you already own. PCBuilderAI researches the market, validates compatibility, and explains every choice.
Hero.trust: Current sources · Deterministic compatibility checks · USA and Ukraine

Features.consultantTitle: A consultant, not a parts list
Features.consultantBody: Ask naturally, revise constraints, and understand what improves performance or saves money.
Features.compatibilityBody: Critical dimensions, sockets, power, firmware, and upgrade constraints are checked before recommendation.
Features.pricingBody: See hardware subtotal separately from estimated tax, delivery, and optional assembly.

Footer.notice: PCBuilderAI is an independent author-created project in public beta. It is not a retailer.
